Download an SPP dataset

Source: R/download.R
spp_data.Rd

Fetches one of the six SPP datasets from the project's GitHub Releases mirror and returns it as a data frame. The file is cached locally (see the local cache), so repeated calls in the same version do not hit the network. The archival, citable copy of every dataset lives on Harvard Dataverse; see spp_citation().

Usage

spp_data(dataset, tag = spp_default_tag(), use_cache = TRUE, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

dataset

Dataset abbreviation, e.g. "SED". See spp_datasets() for the full list. Case-insensitive.

tag

Release tag (version) to download. Defaults to the version this package was built against (v2.0), so results are reproducible. Override to pull a different published version.

use_cache

If TRUE (default), return a previously downloaded copy when available instead of re-downloading.

overwrite

If TRUE, re-download even if a cached copy exists.

Value

A data frame, or NULL (with an informative message) if the data cannot be retrieved - e.g. no internet connection.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Requires an internet connection:
sed <- spp_data("SED")
head(sed)
} # }
